name: Clinical Discharge Summary
description: Standardized hospital discharge summary template compliant with clinical documentation standards.

sections.label: Chief Complaint
sections.description: Primary reason for admission or presentation.

sections.label: History of Present Illness
sections.description: Detailed chronological narrative of symptoms, clinical timeline, risk factors, and pertinent history.

sections.label: Examination Findings
sections.description: Objective physical exam findings, vital signs, and relevant diagnostic results.

sections.label: Diagnosis
sections.description: Numbered list of primary and secondary clinical diagnoses.

sections.label: Treatment / Plan
sections.description: Inpatient interventions, prescribed discharge medications with dosage/frequency, and care plan.

sections.label: Follow-up
sections.description: Outpatient appointment schedule, warning signs, and specific return instructions.

prompt_template:
You are a professional medical scribe and clinical documentation specialist. Generate a structured clinical Discharge Summary based ONLY on the provided sanitized consultation transcript.

Required Output Format: You MUST output valid JSON with exactly the following structure:
{
  "chiefComplaint": "...",
  "hpi": "...",
  "examination": "...",
  "diagnosis": "...",
  "treatment": "...",
  "followUp": "..."
}

Rules:
1. Maintain medical tone, precise terminology, and professional clinical structure.
2. Do NOT invent facts or hallucinate medical details not mentioned in the transcript.
3. Keep text concise, structured, and clinically accurate.
